title: Amazon EC2 C9gd instances now available in additional regions
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with Amazon EC2 C9gd instances now available in additional regions
body_markdown:
Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C9gd instances are available in the Europe (Ireland, Spain) regions. These instances are powered by AWS Graviton5 processors, the fifth generation of custom-designed CPUs, which deliver the best price performance for a broad range of workloads running on Amazon EC2.


[C9gd instances](https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/instance-types/c9g/) deliver up to 25% better compute performance than AWS Graviton4-based C8gd instances. They are up to 30% faster for databases, up to 35% faster for web applications, and up to 35% faster for machine learning. These instances are built on the sixth-generation[AWS Nitro System](https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/nitro/) and are the first to feature the[Nitro Isolation Engine](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/aws-nitro-isolation-engine-formally-verifying-the-hypervisor-in-the-aws-nitro-system/) . The Isolation Engine uses formal verification to provide mathematical assurance that customer workloads are isolated from each other and from AWS operators, pioneering a new standard for mathematically proven cloud security.


C9gd instances are ideal for compute-intensive workloads such as high-performance computing (HPC), batch processing, gaming, video encoding, scientific modeling, distributed analytics, CPU-based machine learning (ML) inference, real-time analytics, and ad serving. They also offer local NVMe-based SSD block-level storage for workloads that need high-speed, low-latency local storage for scratch space, temporary files, and caches.


C9gd instances are available for purchase in these regions via Savings Plans, On-Demand, Spot Instances, Dedicated Instances, or Dedicated Hosts.[Level up your compute with AWS Graviton](https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/graviton/level-up-with-graviton/) and[get started with C9gd today](https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/instance-types/c9g/) .
